 Quick Predictions 
 Score prediction: Le Havre 1-3 PSG 
 Form: Le Havre are winless in Ligue 1 this season; PSG have won five straight league matches. 
 H2H: PSG have won each of the last four league meetings between the sides. 
 Top tip: Second half over 1.5 goals 
 Le Havre face a daunting Ligue 1 assignment on Friday as they welcome PSG to Stade Oceane, with the hosts desperate for a result after a difficult opening to the campaign.
 Les Parisiens have found their rhythm after a slower start to the season, and they currently sit top of the Ligue 1 table, one point above second-placed Rennes.
 Meanwhile, Le Havre currently propping the standings as the only side yet to taste victory in the French top flight this term, and they are five points adrift of safety.
 Read our prediction, preview and betting tips for the game below, and make sure to check out our today's betting tips  page for more of our expert predictions.
 Le Havre vs. PSG key stats 
 Both teams have found the net in five of PSG’s last six away games across all competitions.
 Both of Le Havre’s two league goals at home this season came after the hour mark.
 PSG have won each of their last eight matches across all competitions, six of which produced three or more goals.
 Le Havre have lost six of their eight league games this term, with four of those defeats producing over 2.5 goals.

 Since returning to the French top flight at the beginning of 2023-24, Le Havre have finished in the bottom half of the table in three consecutive seasons, and they are enduring a torrid start to this very campaign.
 No side has suffered more defeats than Le Club Doyen’s six in Ligue 1 this term, having also lost each of their last four league outings.
 However, last weekend’s loss against Marseille offered a rare positive, as Didier Digard's side fought back from four goals behind to within one goal of their opponents, suffering a 4-3 defeat.
 Le Havre vs PSG – Whispers Insight 
 No other side in Ligue 1 has collected fewer home points than Le Havre's one this season.
 The Normandy club’s home performances have also left little margin for error, as Le Havre have gone without a victory at Stade Oceane since beating Toulouse in February, drawing four and losing five league matches during that period.
 PSG travel to Normandy after moving to the top of Ligue 1 with a 2-0 victory over Lyon on Monday, a result that extended their winning sequence to five games in the league.
 Luis Enrique's side have also collected three successive away league victories, giving them a platform to pursue another positive result on the road despite having only three full days to recover from their latest fixture.
 Le Havre vs PSG – Whispers Insight 
PSG have won 11 of their last 12 Ligue 1 meetings with Le Havre. 
 The Parisian club have also shown their quality against elite European opposition this season, recording convincing Champions League victories over Manchester City and Barcelona, and they sit top of the 36-team table.
 PSG enter into Friday’s encounter further buoyed by their dominant record in this very fixture, having recorded wins in each of their last five league visits to Le Havre.

 Whispers predicts: Le Havre 1-3 PSG 
 PSG to win and over 2.5 goals at 1.44 (4/9) is an appealing pick because PSG have the quality to take control against a side that has conceded 11 times across its last four league matches, while the visitors' recent winning run supports the expectation of an away victory.
 Second-half over 1.5 goals at 1.53 (8/15) is also worth backing for those expecting the match to open up after the interval, while both teams to score – yes also stands out considering PSG’s formidable attack and Le Havre’s optimism after their late rally against Marseille.
 A 3-1 correct score victory in favour of PSG at 10.00 (9/1) is a higher-risk selection offering an attractive return for bettors who anticipate the visitors' attacking quality proving decisive without keeping a clean sheet.
